title: VerificationSubject
description: Certified subject record for a materialized merge candidate M (certification continuity contract v10 §1, INV-1..INV-3). One immutable record per subject, stored under data/trusted/subjects/<subjectId>.json. subjectId = sha256Hex('axiom.subject.v1\n' + candidateRef + '\x1f' + candidateCommit + '\x1f' + treeDigest + '\x1f' + baseSha) — the canonical identity wire (hash-kernel SSOT). The store is append-only: an existing subjectId is never overwritten. Enforcement: src/verification/subject_store.nim + src/verification/verification_subject.nim.

subjectId.description: sha256 of the canonical identity wire — the record's immutable key.

candidateRef.description: The candidate ref label the subject was constructed under (e.g. refs/queue/...).

candidateCommit.description: Git OID of the constructed chain tip M (the certification subject).

treeDigest.description: 64-hex sha256 over the constructed tree OID (hash-kernel sha256Hex of the materializer tipTree).

parentCommit.description: Parent of the candidate — equal to baseSha at construction (provenance, not identity).

source.description: Construction path — the sanctioned value is 'merge_materializer'.
